sentences.text: This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.70/2023 registered at Police Station - Singrauli Mahila Police Thana, District Singrauli (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 450 and 506 of IPC.

entities.text: Police Station - Singrauli Mahila Police Thana, District Singrauli
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
Applicant is in detention since 12.12 .2023.
2.

As per the prosecution story, FIR was lodged on 22.11.2023 wherein it is alleged that the complainant runs a beauty parlour where the applicant used to take his mother to her parlour where they both became friends and started talking on mobile phone.

In the month of July, 2023 at about 02:30 in the night, the applicant entered into the house of the prosecutrix when the prosecutrix was sleeping alone in the room and her husband and children were sleeping in another room, the applicant forcibly committed sexual intercourse with her and when the prosecutrix tried to scream

,
he threatened her that he would defame her.
On the basis of aforesaid, Police registered the case against the present applicant under the aforesaid Sections.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 12.12.2023.
He has been falsely implicated.
It is further submitted that prosecutrix is a 33 years old major lady.
This is a matter of consent.
FIR has been lodged after four and a half months.
In FIR, it is mentioned that prosecutrix is pregnant whereas the pregnancy report was negative.
FSL report is also negative.
Charge sheet has been filed.
There is no criminal record of the applicant.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 439 of the Code o f Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
